description_en: Starts a backup-based restoration task by calling the StartRestore operation
description_zh: 调用StartRestore接口启动基于备份的恢复任务
name: StartRestore

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the DRDS instance
parameters.name: drds_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The restoration time of the instance. The value is in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format
parameters.help_zh: 实例的恢复时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

logic: logical backup
phy: fast backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份方式，取值范围如下：
logic：逻辑备份
phy：快速备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en:
The backup level. Valid values:

db: database level
instance: instance level
parameters.help_zh:
备份级别，取值范围如下：
db：数据库级别
instance：实例级别
parameters.name: backup_level

parameters.help_en:
The list of database names to restore. Separate multiple database names with commas (,).
If you do not specify any database names, all databases in the instance are restored by default
parameters.help_zh:
需要恢复的数据库名列表，多个数据库之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
如不填任何数据库名称则默认恢复实例下所有数据库
parameters.name: backup_db_names

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DRDS backup set.
If you do not specify this parameter, the restoration is performed based on the point in time specified by PreferredBackupTime
parameters.help_zh:
DRDS备份集ID。
若不填该参数，则默认按时间点（PreferredBackupTime）恢复
parameters.name: backup_id
